High-level notes up front:

Priyom / Lauren — I ran the numbers. For FastRetail profile (sustained 5B / month, peak 20B):
- PAYG: no commit, list rate with volume step discounts applied monthly; effective blended rate ~ $0.00058/token over a full-year simulated distribution (because high peaks dilute discount impact).
- COMMITTED-BAND (recommended): 6-month min, commit to 6B/mo reported as baseline -> discount ladder: 10% at 6B, 18% at 12B, 25% at 20B. We offer 3 months of conversion credits equal to 15% of their first three months' committed spend (applied as invoice credit).
- ROLLOVER ADD-ON: Unused committed tokens convert to rollover credits up to 20% of monthly committed volume for the next month only.

Concession ask: we can offer a one-time extra 5% off the committed band if they sign an NDA for benchmarking + allow Redwood to publish anonymized performance numbers. Approve?

Ben
Head of Pricing Strategy
